name: NavMeshTileRebuild
signature: public readonly record struct NavMeshTileRebuild(int X, int Z, IReadOnlyList<byte[]> Layers)

docs.summary: The regenerated compressed layers of one navmesh tile, produced by a partial rebuild and applied with [`ApplyRebuiltTiles`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshSurface~ApplyRebuiltTiles). No layers means the tile is now empty.
